prompt: Audit whether this candidate is novel or already scooped by prior work.
candidate_idea: Condition a sequence generator on passages retrieved from a dense Wikipedia index and jointly train retrieval and generation.

prompt: Audit this parameter-efficient fine-tuning candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Freeze a pretrained transformer and learn low-rank matrices injected into its attention projections.

prompt: Audit this image-text representation candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Contrastively pretrain an image encoder and text encoder on web-scale image-caption pairs for zero-shot recognition.

prompt: Audit this preference-optimization candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Optimize a language model directly from preference pairs with a closed-form objective and no explicit reward model.

prompt: Audit this exact-attention acceleration candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Compute exact attention with IO-aware tiling to reduce high-bandwidth-memory traffic while preserving outputs.

prompt: Audit this promptable image segmentation candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Train a promptable segmentation model on a large mask dataset to generalize zero-shot across image domains.

prompt: Audit this robust speech-recognition pretraining candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Weakly supervise a large encoder-decoder speech model on hundreds of thousands of hours of multilingual audio and transcripts.

prompt: Audit this graph-convolution candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Use localized first-order spectral graph convolutions for semi-supervised node classification.

prompt: Audit this bidirectional language pretraining candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Pretrain a deep bidirectional transformer using masked-token prediction and next-sentence prediction, then fine-tune it.

prompt: Audit this reasoning-and-action agent candidate against known prior art.
candidate_idea: Interleave natural-language reasoning traces with environment actions so an agent can update plans from observations.

prompt: Judge the novelty of transferring retrieval-augmented generation to speech translation.
candidate_idea: Retrieve parallel utterance examples and condition speech translation on them without changing the retrieval or generation mechanism.
expected_behavior: do not call strong without mechanism novelty

prompt: Judge the novelty of applying low-rank adapters to molecular property prediction transformers.
candidate_idea: Insert standard low-rank adapters into a molecular transformer and train them on property labels.
expected_behavior: rank weak unless domain creates new scientific claim

prompt: Judge the novelty of applying chain-of-thought prompting to malware triage.
candidate_idea: Prompt a language model to produce step-by-step reasoning before classifying malware reports.

prompt: Judge the novelty of transferring direct preference optimization to text-to-image models.
candidate_idea: Use the standard direct preference objective on preferred and rejected generated images without changing its mechanism.

prompt: Judge the novelty of applying conformal prediction to recommender-system confidence.
candidate_idea: Wrap recommendation scores with an off-the-shelf conformal prediction interval under exchangeability.
expected_behavior: do not label strong by application alone

prompt: Judge the novelty of adding a vector memory database to a code-repair agent.
candidate_idea: Store past repair traces in a vector database and retrieve nearest examples before each repair.

prompt: Judge the novelty of applying mixture-of-experts routing to database query optimization.
candidate_idea: Use a standard learned top-k router to select specialized query-optimization experts.

prompt: Judge the novelty of applying masked autoencoding to speaker diarization.
candidate_idea: Pretrain a speech encoder by masking spans and reconstructing them before diarization fine-tuning.

prompt: Judge the novelty of applying self-consistency decoding to vulnerability analysis.
candidate_idea: Sample multiple vulnerability analyses and select the majority conclusion without modifying the model.

prompt: Judge the novelty of applying contrastive image-text pretraining to microscopy and captions.
candidate_idea: Train standard contrastive encoders on paired microscopy images and laboratory captions for zero-shot classification.
